# Release record – 0.2.0 (2026-10-29)

Kalshi reference lanes (`fed`, `crossvenue`) and the day-1 pilot fixes
(TP-5..TP-8). Pre-registration of the two pilots that start with this
release ([`GO-NO-GO.md` §3.2](../RELEASE-GATE.md#32-pre-registration-every-stage)).
**Do not edit the pre-registered files after the start.** A changed hash
means a new pilot with a new record.

## Code

| Repository | Commit | Tag |
|---|---|---|
| trading-polymarket | `8a15390` (code; this record is the next commit, tagged) | `v0.2.0` |
| trading-core | `2f4f1aa4972d9d7ec1666e574b85c6f5353b3aaf` (unchanged by this release) | `v0.2.0` |

The pilots run from tagged copies with their own venv, never from the
working repos: `runtime-trading/bin/install-release.sh v0.2.0 v0.2.0`
clones both tags into `runtime-trading/releases/` (never edited; the
script refuses a dirty or moved copy) and installs those copies into
`runtime-trading/venvs/polymarket-v0.2.0/`, editable so that every run's
`run_started` records both commits (`git_commit`, `module_git`). Each
LaunchAgent names that venv explicitly (`runtime-trading/README.md`).

| File | sha256 |

| `history/fed.jsonl` (17 settled meetings, Dec 2024 – Oct 2026, 58 buckets; collected 2026-10-29) | `106301c90ed54e1748f4ee76221f78d7169126a293d3b1b6417dfc2ef3543236` |

Fed replay (default settings, half-spread 0.01): 16 meetings used (1
disagreement skipped), 23 trades, net +$25.08, adjusted +$23.15; verdict
NO-GO on `min_positions` only (23 < 60); +$17.89 at half-spread 0.02.
Kalshi's Brier score is not below Polymarket's at any horizon.
